# Distance Calculation

**Formula:** Distance = Speed × Time

**Given information:**
- Speed = 60 km/h
- Time = 2.5 hours

**Calculation:**
$$\text{Distance} = 60 \text{ km/h} \times 2.5 \text{ h} = 150 \text{ km}$$

**The train travels 150 kilometres.**
